stem.en: After the pea activity, a student writes: "The bag caused the pods, because pods formed inside the bags." Which observation shows that this is wrong?

text.en: No flower inside a bag formed a pod

feedback.en: False. Flowers inside bags did form pods.

text.en: The flower with no bag formed no pod

feedback.en: False. The uncovered flower did form a pod.

text.en: A flower with no bag also formed a pod

feedback.en: Yes. A pod formed with no bag at all, so the bag is not the cause.

text.en: Every one of the five flowers formed a pod in its bag

feedback.en: False. One flower gave no pod, and one had no bag.

explanation.en: To test a claimed cause, look for the result without it. The uncovered flower formed a pod with no bag, so the bag did not cause the pods.

hints.en: To test a cause, take the cause away. What happens then?
Was there a flower with no bag?
